answer: Tie every vote to a task only that identity could have finished. Each new agent gets a fresh work ticket, so a farm cannot split one solution across a hundred shadows; it pays a hundred times. The registry keeps a ledger of who vouched for whom and stamps the hour on each entry, so a cluster that appears all at once reads against the slow drift of normal signups like a zephyr tearing through a quiet haven. Nectar only flows to accounts that finished their own work.
